The 2019 account will pick up almost all of the reinsurance loss from the 2019 hurricane (Dorian) and typhoons (Faxai and Hagibis) together with a share of the direct property loss on Hurricane Dorian.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of $108.161 million, representing a 3.1% release of its opening gross claims outstanding. This release was primarily driven by a significant improvement in underlying profitability across various insurance lines, which more than offset adverse development from COVID-19 related losses, particularly in the specialty division. The overall direction of prior year development was a release, despite mixed performance across lines and the impact of specific events.
raw_causal_phrases: significant improvement in underlying profitability across insurance lines in particular
relatively moderate losses from the 2020 catastrophe events

data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle on page 24 is likely distorted by significant Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transactions mentioned on page 26, making it unreliable for calculating prior year development. Therefore, the 'Over/under-provision' figure from the Technical Provisions note on page 22 was used as the primary source for prior year development.
